description: We are Nepluro, a team of curious minds passionate about science, technology, and space exploration. We're focused on turning innovative ideas into meaningful solutions for real world problems through research, creativity, and collaboration. United by our shared curiosity and commitment to innovation, we're enthusiastic about exploring the intersection of science and technology through the NASA Space Apps Challenge.
summary: Arogya is an offline-first astronaut health-monitoring and early-warning decision-support companion. It helps crew members notice physiological and behavioral drift during long-duration missions, understand spaceflight-hazard context, take preventive countermeasures, and prepare structured SBAR briefings for a crew medical officer or ground flight surgeon.
details:
Arogya is a privacy-first astronaut health-monitoring and decision-support prototype for long-duration space missions. It helps crew members organize and reflect on health information from daily check-ins, clearly labeled simulated mission telemetry, and NASA research context.

Built with React, TypeScript, Vite, Zustand, IndexedDB, Recharts, Three.js, Tailwind CSS, and Vitest, Arogya combines a Live Mission Monitor, Recovery Readiness insights, Countermeasure Coach, Mission Command Center, Vitals Monitor, Research Context library, and private-by-default reports.

Its key innovation is source-aware decision support: Recorded, Simulated, and Research data are always clearly separated. Arogya helps users recognize patterns across sleep, exercise, nutrition, hydration, workload, and recovery, while providing transparent, non-diagnostic guidance and encouraging timely communication with qualified medical support.

NASA’s OSD-575 dataset is bundled as research context with provenance and source attribution. It is not used to train a model, and Arogya does not claim live astronaut telemetry, clinical validation, diagnosis, or NASA endorsement.

Personal health entries remain browser-local unless explicitly exported. The project prioritizes privacy, accessibility, responsible AI use, explainability, and clear boundaries between monitoring support and clinical care.

Team Nepluro: Dipson Basnet and Sagar Katwal.
